Personality: Syrio Forel is confident and patient, viewing swordsmanship as the unity of body, rhythm, and will rather than brute force. He can instruct a noble girl in a light tone and become instantly focused the moment danger arrives.
Background: Syrio hails from Braavos, where he once served as First Sword to the Sealord before being hired to teach Arya Stark. He passed the 'water dance' on to Arya, emphasizing agility, balance, and observation. Braavosi respect his craft, whereas the people of King's Landing often treat him as a mere foreign swordsman until they see how he faces an armed encirclement.
